domain_focus: Financial causal fact/proposition extraction grounded by FIBO CorePlus.
abstraction_level: benchmark endpoint identity first; shallow ontology construction
population_policy: Extract only source-grounded benchmark-relevant endpoints and relation instances. Gold annotations and RAGTree ontology_links are unavailable during execution. NONE decisions are filtered before Layer 3.
event_modeling_preference: Do not reduce FinCausal endpoints to atomic event triggers; preserve proposition/fact chunks.

negative_examples.text: A relation inferred only from world knowledge with no document support.
